objects.name: ECDSA nonce-width timing analysis
objects.description: An observer correlates signing latency with nonce bit length across ECDSA signatures, then uses bounded nonce information and the public signature values in a Hidden Number Problem recovery. This describes a technique class, not an observed campaign or affected product.

objects.name: Remove nonce-dependent signing timing
objects.description: Identify affected implementations, use a side-channel-resistant signing path, verify timing behavior with controlled nonce widths, and rotate keys if exposure is established. Deterministic nonce derivation alone does not remove variable-time scalar multiplication.
